note: D2 shrine reroll (config mutators [spinning_shrine], the switch the sink lives behind - a default run never lists the action): standing on the counter the tender spins it once for 2 bloom and every re-drawable slot redraws from its own side generator - root_wall -> moss_filter, [bloom_surge, verdant_pulse] -> [compost, carapace], spore_vial -> clearair_pod - none of them the offer that was standing there, while heal / press / forge are left alone. A spin costs bloom and no charge, and the cleanse after it pins the purse at 10 - 2 + 1 = 9
